subject: Private deployment procurement - technical appendix and handover plan
content:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Walker <alice.walker@orionfinancial.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment procurement - technical appendix and handover plan

Alice —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attached is the technical appendix tailored for the Orion Financial RFP. It contains the deployment architecture, required network flows, operator handover checklist, and a proposed schedule for secrets transfer in an on-prem/VPC installation.

Quick summary of items in the package:
- Architecture diagram (network-diagram-v1.png) with subnet mapping and NAT/egress controls.
- Operator handover checklist (handover-checklist.xlsx) that covers service accounts, KMS/HSM handoff, and runbook ownership.
- Private ops appendix (redwood-private-ops-appendix.pdf) with quantization/replication recommendations, expected throughput by machine type, and fallbacks for isolated environments.

Action items for Orion: please confirm the required maintenance window for initial install, any procurement constraints on outbound traffic (we noted your procurement note about restricted egress), and the preferred PKI transition plan for HSM integration.

We can be available Wednesday or Thursday for a 30-minute technical handoff with your infra and procurement teams.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Walker <alice.walker@orionfinancial.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Sanchez <bob.sanchez@orionfinancial.com>, Orion Financial Procurement <procurement@orionfinancial.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment procurement - technical appendix and handover plan

Karthik —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear call. A few clarifying questions from our infra and security teams before we set the handoff meeting:

1) For the HSM integration, can you confirm Redwood supports Azure Key Vault Managed HSM and Thales Luna in FIPS mode? If there are any additional connector components required, list them.
2) Network: the diagram shows a required outbound connection to redwood-control.redwood.com:443 for telemetry. For our air-gapped variant we need to know exactly which API calls are required and whether a proxy-based pull model is supported (we cannot permit inbound connections from internet).
3) Operator access: your handover checklist references an SSO-provisioned operator role. We use Okta SCIM; does Redwood support SCIM provisioning for operator/service accounts and role sync?
4) Maintenance windows: preferred window is Saturday 02:00–06:00 UTC. Can you support initial install then?

Also: please provide the most recent SBOM and any attestations around build provenance for the runtime.

If you can reply with short answers and the network diagram as a standalone PNG, we'll align procurement and security and get back with exact availability for the handoff.

Best,
Alice Walker
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Orion Financial

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Walker <alice.walker@orionfinancial.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment procurement - technical appendix and handover plan

Alice —

Thanks for the questions; answers below (concise):

1) HSM support: We have validated integrations with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM and Thales Luna (FIPS 140-2/140-3 modes). No additional long-lived connector is required — we deploy a lightweight connector container that performs certificate-based mutual TLS to the HSM endpoint inside the VPC. Details and cert rotation steps are in section 3.2 of the appendix.

2) Telemetry & control plane: For on-prem/air-gapped installs we support a pull-only model. The operator node initiates outbound-only HTTPS to a control endpoint and can be configured to use a customer-managed proxy. Telemetry is limited to anonymized metrics and health pings; no customer prompts or model payloads leave the environment unless explicitly enabled in the install profile. The appendix lists the exact control endpoints, ports (443), and the Swagger paths required for health checks and job scheduling.

3) SCIM/SSO provisioning: Redwood supports Okta SCIM for provisioning operator/service accounts and role mappings. We provide a SCIM connector that runs in-cluster; it does not require internet egress after initial setup if you seed the token and connector with a local OKTA mirror.

4) Maintenance window: Saturday 02:00–06:00 UTC works for our deployment team. Please confirm timezone for your central scheduling (we assume UTC).

SBOM & provenance: Attached is a signed SBOM snapshot (referenced in the appendix). We also include a build provenance manifest and a short attestation statement for the runtime binaries.

Attachments included in this email: network-diagram-v1.png, redwood-private-ops-appendix.pdf, handover-checklist.xlsx

Next steps: once you confirm maintenance window and proxy approach, we'll schedule the 30-minute handoff with our deploy lead (Marcus) and our security reviewer (Monica).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference

---

From: Bob Sanchez <bob.sanchez@orionfinancial.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment procurement - technical appendix and handover plan

Vanessa / Karthik —

All good on our side; these answers address the security and integration concerns. We accept the proposed maintenance window (Saturday 02:00–06:00 UTC) and will provision a customer-managed proxy as described. Procurement is ready to proceed to contract signature — please send the statement-of-work and order form to procurement@orionfinancial.com and CC me.

One operational note: our security team asked that the handover checklist include a line for emergency rollback validation (we'll reference your rollback playbook). If you can surface that in the final checklist prior to install it will accelerate approvals.

Thanks,
Bob Sanchez
Procurement Lead
Orion Financial
